entries: Truffade Z-Type is a Sports Classics car and the fastest conventional car in tested Story Mode top-speed rankings, reaching about 127 mph when fully upgraded. It is extremely expensive in Story Mode.
Truffade Adder is a supercar inspired by high-end Bugatti design. It is one of the fastest Story Mode cars at about 126.25 mph in tested top-speed runs and can also be found in the world.
where to get Vapid Pißwasser Dominator
Vapid Pißwasser Dominator is a special muscle car unlocked through Stock Car Racing in supported Story Mode editions. It ranks among the fastest Story Mode cars in tested top-speed lists.
Pegassi Monroe is a classic sports car with strong top speed and handling, available in Story Mode through the vehicle website.
Dewbauchee Massacro is a fast sports car available in Story Mode and one of the stronger non-supercar performance choices.
Progen T20 is a high-end supercar added before Story Mode vehicle support stopped receiving newer Online DLC cars. In supported Story Mode editions it is purchasable and very fast.
where to get Grotti Turismo R
Grotti Turismo R is a high-performance supercar available in Story Mode, combining excellent speed with stable handling.
where to get Överflöd Entity XF
Överflöd Entity XF is a Story Mode supercar known for balanced acceleration, handling, and high speed. It appears in the mission I Fought the Law... and can be bought for personal use.
Pegassi Zentorno is a high-performance supercar available in Story Mode in supported editions, popular for strong acceleration and handling.
Pegassi Osiris is a high-end Story Mode supercar from the Ill-Gotten Gains-era content, purchasable in supported versions.
Obey 9F is a quick sports car based loosely on the Audi R8 concept, available to steal or purchase in Story Mode.
Obey 9F Cabrio is the convertible version of the 9F, offering similar performance with open-top styling.
Benefactor Surano is a sports convertible with strong speed and an accessible purchase price compared with supercars.
Vapid Dominator is a powerful muscle car commonly found in Story Mode traffic and a strong option for players who prefer muscle-car handling.
Karin Sultan is an all-wheel-drive sports sedan found on the street, valued for balanced handling and four-door practicality.
Benefactor Schwartzer is a fast sports coupe that can be found in traffic and is a good budget-friendly performance car.
where to get Bravado Buffalo S
Bravado Buffalo S is Franklin's signature car. It is persistent, respawns with Franklin, and is a good long-term vehicle to upgrade because modifications can stay with his personal car.
Obey Tailgater is Michael's signature sedan. It is persistent and respawns for Michael, making it useful for upgrades and everyday Story Mode driving.
Canis Bodhi is Trevor's signature off-road pickup. It is persistent and suited to Blaine County's rough terrain.
Western Bagger is a motorcycle associated with Franklin after Repossession and usable as an additional personal-style vehicle.
Pegassi Bati 801 is a high-performance sport motorcycle that combines strong acceleration, speed, and handling in Story Mode.
Dinka Akuma is a lightweight sport motorcycle known for rapid acceleration and responsive handling.
Maibatsu Sanchez is a dirt bike ideal for off-road routes, mountains, jumps, and rough terrain.
Canis Mesa is an SUV/off-road vehicle with useful ground clearance; military-style variants appear in some missions and areas.
Karin Rebel is an off-road pickup suited to desert and dirt-road driving in Blaine County.
where to get Vapid Sandking XL
Vapid Sandking XL is a large lifted pickup with excellent ground clearance and strong off-road usefulness.
Benefactor Dubsta is an SUV with solid off-road ability and good all-purpose road behavior.
Declasse Granger is a large SUV that offers four-door practicality and decent durability for missions.
Cheval Fugitive is a four-door sedan that balances speed, passenger capacity, and everyday handling.
Bravado Gauntlet is a muscle car used prominently in the subtle Big Score preparations and available for general driving.
Dewbauchee JB 700 is a classic spy-style sports car featured in Deep Inside. The Story Mode mission version includes film-prop gadgets, while normal ownership differs.
Grotti Cheetah is a high-end supercar used in I Fought the Law... and available as a Story Mode performance vehicle.
Pegassi Infernus is a classic GTA supercar with high speed and strong performance, commonly recognized as one of the series' flagship exotic cars.
Pfister Comet is a rear-engine sports car with quick handling, useful for players who prefer agile road cars.
where to get Annis Elegy RH8
Annis Elegy RH8 is a high-performance sports car available as a special vehicle in some Story Mode versions and associated with Rockstar Social Club bonuses.
Vapid Bullet is a supercar with a balanced mid-engine layout and solid Story Mode performance.
Coil Voltic is an electric sports car with instant-feeling acceleration but lower ultimate top speed than the fastest supercars.
where to get Dewbauchee Rapid GT
Dewbauchee Rapid GT is a sports car available in coupe and convertible forms, offering balanced road performance.
Ocelot F620 is a luxury sports coupe found in traffic, useful as an accessible high-end-looking street car.
Lampadati Felon is a luxury coupe/sedan-style performance car that can be found in wealthier Los Santos districts.
Albany Cavalcade is an SUV offering passenger capacity and everyday utility rather than top-tier performance.
Mammoth Patriot is a large SUV with rugged styling and reasonable durability, but heavier handling than sports vehicles.
BF Bifta is a lightweight off-road buggy useful for dunes, trails, and playful off-road driving.
Nagasaki Blazer is an ATV suited to dirt trails and off-road routes but with less protection than enclosed vehicles.
